name: orsem
description: OpenDART-centered disclosure, insider ownership and market-news observatory

scripts.build:packages: npm run build -w @orsem/contracts && npm run build -w @orsem/database && npm run build -w @orsem/opendart-parser
scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build -w @orsem/api && npm run build -w @orsem/worker && npm run build -w @orsem/discord-bot && npm run build -w @orsem/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:packages && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test: npm run build:packages && npm run test:scripts && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test:unit: npm run build:packages && npm run test:unit --workspaces --if-present
scripts.check: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run check:messenger-script
